fixed_common_support.rule: same prediction pixels (rows/cols 2..13) and pixels valid in all 25 shifted reference masks for each sample

offset_convention: dy,dx shift applied to CPP reference relative to fixed prediction coordinate; no label movement authorized
provenance_limits: The original AGRI NPZ files referenced by the manifest were not readable from the current SSH account (permission denied); timestamps and source hashes are recorded in the manifest/sidecar, but raw AGRI values were not independently reopened in this audit.

The historical 2025 CPP NetCDF files expose COT/CLP/LAT/LON but no QA variable; source crop agreement and clear-class semantics can be verified, but historical producer/checkpoint and fallback/invalid-retrieval provenance cannot be proven from this file alone.
Offset results compare the frozen R model prediction against shifted CPP retrieval labels; this is a sensitivity diagnostic, not independent validation truth and cannot justify shifting labels.
